## Design — Section 5: Auth & Security

---

### A. Authentication layers

**Existing (unchanged):**
- `authenticateApiKey` — API key in `PROMPTS_API_KEY` header → resolves to `User`
- Session auth — NextAuth cookie → resolves to `User`

**New:**
- `assertPublisher(user)` — Phase 1: checks `user.username === "le-dawg"`. Phase 2+: checks `user.role === ADMIN`. Applied to `POST /api/collections` and collection write MCP tools.
- `assertOwner(user, collection)` — checks `collection.ownerId === user.id`. Applied to all destructive operations.
- `assertAdminOrOwner(user, collection)` — checks owner OR `user.role === ADMIN`. Applied to Patch on PUBLIC collections.

---

### B. Access control — enforced at DB query layer, not API layer only

`USER_PRIVATE` — query always appends `WHERE ownerId = authenticatedUserId`. Admin role explicitly excluded. No override.

`ADMIN_PRIVATE` — query: `WHERE ownerId = userId OR (role = ADMIN) OR (EXISTS CollectionMember WHERE userId = authenticatedUserId)`

`PUBLIC` — no auth required for read. Write requires `assertAdminOrOwner`.

**Rule:** visibility check happens inside the Prisma query, not after fetching. A `USER_PRIVATE` collection never reaches application code for another user — it simply returns 404 (not 403, to avoid confirming existence).

---

### C. Content integrity for INTERNAL items

When `sourceType = INTERNAL`, the download endpoint serves plugin files. Add nullable `contentHash` back to `CollectionItem`:

```prisma
contentHash  String?  // SHA-256 of served file content — computed on write, returned in marketplace.json sha field
```

`marketplace.json` entry for INTERNAL items includes `"sha": "<hash>"` — Claude Code and other Tier 1 agents verify this on install. Consumers detect tampering before execution.

---

### D. SSRF protection

Two entry points accept external URLs:

**`CollectionItem.sourceUrl`** — validated on write:
- Must match `https://github.com/` or `https://gitlab.com/` pattern
- Reject: `localhost`, `127.x`, `10.x`, `192.168.x`, `169.254.x`, IPv6 loopback
- Reject: non-HTTPS schemes

**`update_agent_config` auto-fetch** — allowlisted domains only:
```typescript
const FETCH_ALLOWLIST = [
  "github.com", "raw.githubusercontent.com",
  "docs.anthropic.com", "cursor.com", "openai.com",
  "kilo.ai", "docs.windsurf.com", "cline.bot",
  "docs.github.com", "antigravity.google"
]
```
Fetch rejected if resolved hostname not in allowlist. Prevents server-side request to internal network.

---

### E. Rate limiting

| Endpoint | Limit | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `GET marketplace.json` (unauthenticated) | 60 req/min | per IP |
| `GET marketplace.json` (authenticated) | 300 req/min | per API key |
| `set_me_up` | 10 req/hour | per user |
| `update_agent_config` | 1 req/hour | per agentId per admin |
| `install_collection` | 30 req/hour | per user |

Implemented via existing Next.js middleware layer.

---

### F. Audit trail

New model:

```prisma
model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String   // "install_collection", "update_agent_config", "set_me_up", etc.
  target    String?  // collectionId, agentId, etc.
  meta      Json?    // agent type, check results, diff summary
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}
```

Logged: `install_collection`, `set_me_up` (with check results), `update_agent_config` (with before/after diff), collection create/delete, visibility changes.

---

### G. Supply chain mitigations vs. research findings

From our earlier research (17 attack vectors). Phase 1 mitigations:

| Attack vector | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Malicious script in plugin files | INTERNAL items: SHA-256 hash verified on install. Admin-reviewed before APPROVED. |
| Post-install weaponization | `sourceRef` pinned to commit SHA optionally. `upstreamRef` tracks last known SHA. |
| Namespace collision | `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` — scoped to owner, no cross-user overwrite. |
| SSRF via sourceUrl | Domain allowlist + IP range rejection on write. |
| `update_agent_config` prompt injection | Fetched content presented as diff for admin confirmation — never auto-applied. |
| Credential exposure in marketplace.json | API key never included in served `marketplace.json`. Auth via header only. |

**Not mitigated in Phase 1** (documented for Phase 4): code signing, sandboxing, supply chain attestations.

---

Section 5 done. Sections 1–5 now cover full Phase 1 scope. Ready to write the spec doc, or want Section 6 (testing matrix) first?

## Design — Section 6: Testing Matrix

Scope: Phase 1 only. Grouped by surface.

---

### 6.1 Data Model / DB

| Test | Type | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| Create collection — owner scoped correctly | Unit | `collection.ownerId === authenticatedUser.id` |
| `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` enforced | Unit | Second insert same owner+slug throws unique constraint |
| Same slug different owner allowed | Unit | Two users can have `slug = "tdd"` without collision |
| `USER_PRIVATE` invisible to other users | Integration | Query as user B for user A's `USER_PRIVATE` → 0 rows returned |
| `USER_PRIVATE` invisible to admin/le-dawg | Integration | Query as admin for other user's `USER_PRIVATE` → 0 rows returned |
| `ADMIN_PRIVATE` visible to admins | Integration | Admin user queries other admin's `ADMIN_PRIVATE` → row returned |
| `ADMIN_PRIVATE` visible to invited member | Integration | Non-admin with `CollectionMember` entry → row returned |
| `ADMIN_PRIVATE` invisible to public | Integration | Unauthenticated query → 0 rows |
| `CollectionItem.sourceUrl` SSRF validation | Unit | `localhost`, `192.168.x`, `10.x` rejected on write |
| `sourceUrl` non-HTTPS rejected | Unit | `http://` scheme rejected |
| `@@unique([collectionId, order])` enforced | Unit | Duplicate order within collection throws |
| `contentHash` computed on INTERNAL write | Unit | SHA-256 of file content stored correctly |
| `AuditLog` entry created on install | Integration | `install_collection` call → AuditLog row exists |

---

### 6.2 API Routes

| Test | Type | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| `GET marketplace.json` — PUBLIC, unauthenticated | Integration | 200, valid Claude Code marketplace.json schema |
| `GET marketplace.json` — ADMIN_PRIVATE, no auth | Integration | 404 |
| `GET marketplace.json` — ADMIN_PRIVATE, valid API key | Integration | 200 |
| `GET marketplace.json` — USER_PRIVATE, owner API key | Integration | 200 |
| `GET marketplace.json` — USER_PRIVATE, other user API key | Integration | 404 |
| `GET marketplace.json` — LOCAL items excluded | Integration | LOCAL CollectionItems absent from response |
| `GET marketplace.json` — INTERNAL items include download URL + sha | Integration | `source.url` points to `/items/[id]/download`, `sha` present |
| `POST /api/collections` — non-admin rejected | Integration | Non-admin user → 403 |
| `POST /api/collections` — admin creates successfully | Integration | 201, collection in DB |
| `DELETE /api/collections/[u]/[s]` — owner only | Integration | Non-owner → 403; owner → 204 |
| `PATCH` collection item — admin on PUBLIC | Integration | Admin (non-owner) can patch item on PUBLIC collection |
| `PATCH` collection item — admin on USER_PRIVATE | Integration | Admin → 404 (existence not revealed) |
| `POST /items/reorder` — owner only | Integration | Non-owner → 403 |
| `GET /items/[id]/download` — INTERNAL item | Integration | Returns plugin files, Content-Hash header matches stored hash |
| Rate limit `marketplace.json` unauthenticated | Integration | 61st req/min from same IP → 429 |
| Rate limit `set_me_up` | Integration | 11th call/hour same user → 429 |

---

### 6.3 MCP Tools

| Test | Type | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| `get_collections` — returns own + public + ADMIN_PRIVATE (admin) | Integration | Correct visibility filtering |
| `get_collections` — excludes other users' USER_PRIVATE | Integration | Zero USER_PRIVATE rows from other users |
| `create_collection` — non-admin rejected Phase 1 | Unit | `username !== "le-dawg"` → error result |
| `update_collection_item add` — owner adds item | Integration | Item created, order assigned |
| `update_collection_item remove` — non-owner rejected | Integration | Error: permission denied |
| `update_collection_item` — admin adds to PUBLIC (non-own) | Integration | Success |
| `update_collection_item remove` — admin on PUBLIC (non-own) | Integration | Error: delete owner-only |
| `reorder_collection` — non-owner rejected | Integration | Error: permission denied |
| `install_collection` — LOCAL items skipped with warning | Unit | `skipped` array contains LOCAL items, `commands` excludes them |
| `install_collection` — Tier 1 agent generates marketplace.json command | Unit | Output contains `/plugin marketplace add` or equivalent |
| `install_collection` — Tier 2 agent generates npx skills command | Unit | Output contains `npx skills add` for SKILL items |
| `install_collection` — MCP items always config injection | Unit | MCP items never use npx skills path |
| `set_me_up` — idempotent on rerun | Integration | Second run returns same success, no duplicate registrations |
| `set_me_up` — missing `read:org` scope triggers elicitation | Integration | Elicitation message returned when GitHub API returns 403 |
| `set_me_up` — non-org member fails with remediation | Integration | Check 3 fail → hard stop + "contact le-dawg" message |
| `set_me_up` — agent detection fallback to elicitation | Unit | Unknown user-agent → elicitation list of 9 agents returned |
| `update_agent_config` — non-admin rejected | Unit | Non-admin user → error result |
| `update_agent_config` — fetches only allowlisted domains | Unit | Attempt to fetch `192.168.1.1` → rejected |
| `update_agent_config` — rate limited | Integration | Second call within 1 hour same agentId → error |

---

### 6.4 `marketplace.json` Schema Compliance

| Test | Type | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| Output validates against Claude Code schema | Unit | All required fields present, types correct |
| Copilot CLI can register endpoint | E2E | `copilot plugin marketplace add <url>` succeeds |
| Codex CLI can register endpoint | E2E | `codex plugin marketplace add <url>` succeeds |
| Antigravity CLI can register endpoint | E2E | `/plugin marketplace add <url>` succeeds |
| GITHUB item resolves to correct source URL + ref | Unit | `source.url` = `sourceUrl`, `source.ref` = `sourceRef` |
| INTERNAL item resolves to download endpoint + sha | Unit | `source.url` = platform download URL, `sha` = `contentHash` |

---

### 6.5 Security

| Test | Type | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| `sourceUrl` with `localhost` rejected | Unit | 400 on collection item write |
| `sourceUrl` with private IP range rejected | Unit | 400 |
| `sourceUrl` with `http://` rejected | Unit | 400 |
| `USER_PRIVATE` returns 404 not 403 to others | Integration | Existence not revealed |
| `contentHash` mismatch on download detected | Unit | Modified file content → hash mismatch flagged |
| `update_agent_config` off-allowlist domain rejected | Unit | 400 |
| `AuditLog` written for all sensitive actions | Integration | install, set_me_up, update_agent_config all logged |
| Publisher gate — only le-dawg creates in Phase 1 | Unit | Other admin → 403 |

---

### 6.6 End-to-End

| Scenario | Pass condition |
|---|---|
| New admin: login → settings → MCP connect → `set_me_up` → marketplace registered → `install_collection` → plugin active in Claude Code session | Full flow completes, plugin available in session |
| Admin creates PUBLIC collection → another admin adds item → owner reorders → Tier 1 agent installs | All steps succeed, install order matches reorder |
| Admin attempts to read another admin's USER_PRIVATE collection via MCP | 404, no error reveals existence |
| `update_agent_config` fetch → diff presented → admin confirms → AgentConfig updated → `set_me_up` uses new config | Config update reflected in next `set_me_up` run |

---

Section 6 done. All sections covered. Ready to write the spec doc to `docs/superpowers/specs/`?

# PromptBar Phase 1 — Collections & Marketplace Design Spec

**Date:** 2026-06-02
**Author:** le-dawg + Claude Code
**Status:** Approved for implementation planning
**Scope:** Phase 1 only — Collections, Marketplace Distribution, `set_me_up`, Agent Compat

---

## 1. Context & Scope

PromptBar becomes a Git-native team distribution platform for Skills and Plugin Marketplaces. This spec covers Phase 1 exclusively.

**Phase 1 delivers:**
- User-owned Collections (named, versioned lists of skills + MCPs)
- Platform-served `marketplace.json` compatible with Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex, Antigravity
- `set_me_up` MCP tool — org-verified onboarding + marketplace registration
- Agent compatibility registry (`AgentConfig`) — server-side, admin-updatable via MCP
- Onboarding UX block in `/settings`
- Skills system unchanged

**Out of scope (Phase 2+):**
- `.skill` upload hardening + manifest standardization
- Skill sync pull (Phase 2)
- Skill push + conflict resolution (Phase 3)
- Code signing, attestations, strict policy gates (Phase 4)
- OAuth write scope expansion for GitHub push (Phase 3 prerequisite)

---

## 2. Data Model

### 2.1 New Prisma Models

```prisma
model Collection {
  id          String               @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String
  name        String
  description String?
  visibility  CollectionVisibility @default(USER_PRIVATE)
  ownerId     String
  owner       User                 @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  items       CollectionItem[]
  members     CollectionMember[]
  createdAt   DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime             @updatedAt

  @@unique([ownerId, slug])
  @@map("collections")
}

model CollectionItem {
  id           String         @id @default(cuid())
  order        Int
  name         String
  description  String?
  sourceType   ItemSourceType @default(GITHUB)
  sourceUrl    String?        // GitHub/GitLab URL — required when sourceType = GITHUB
  sourcePath   String?        // subdirectory within repo
  sourceRef    String         @default("main")
  promptId     String?        // required when sourceType = INTERNAL
  prompt       Prompt?        @relation(fields: [promptId], references: [id])
  contentHash  String?        // SHA-256 of served content — INTERNAL items only
  type         ItemType
  lastSyncedAt DateTime?
  syncStatus   SyncStatus?
  upstreamRef  String?        // last known upstream commit SHA
  collectionId String
  collection   Collection     @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id])
  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now())

  @@unique([collectionId, order])
  @@map("collection_items")
}

model CollectionMember {
  collectionId String
  userId       String
  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@id([collectionId, userId])
  @@map("collection_members")
}

model AgentConfig {
  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
  agentId           String    @unique  // "claude-code", "copilot-cli", "codex", "antigravity", etc.
  displayName       String
  tier              AgentTier
  pluginRegisterCmd String?   // template string; {host}, {username}, {slug} substituted at runtime
  pluginInstallCmd  String?
  mcpConfigTemplate Json?     // per-agent config injection format
  skillsPathGlobal  String?
  skillsPathProject String?
  npxSkillsFlag     String?   // e.g. "--agent claude"
  cliCheckCmd       String?   // e.g. "claude --version"
  docsUrl           String?   // source for auto-fetch update
  isActive          Boolean   @default(true)
  lastUpdatedAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedById       String?

  @@map("agent_configs")
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  target    String?
  meta      Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}
```

### 2.2 New Enums

```prisma
enum CollectionVisibility {
  PUBLIC        // anyone reads; le-dawg can unpublish others'
  ADMIN_PRIVATE // org admins + invited CollectionMembers read; hidden from public
  USER_PRIVATE  // owner only — no exceptions, returns 404 to all others including admins
}

enum ItemSourceType {
  GITHUB    // sourceUrl points to GitHub/GitLab repo; Claude Code fetches natively
  INTERNAL  // skill stored as Prompt record in platform DB; served via download endpoint
  LOCAL     // lives on user's machine only; excluded from marketplace.json and install commands
}

enum ItemType {
  SKILL
  MCP
}

enum SyncStatus {
  IN_SYNC
  AHEAD
  BEHIND
  DIVERGED
  CONFLICT
  ERROR
}

enum AgentTier {
  MARKETPLACE_NATIVE  // supports marketplace.json + /plugin commands natively
  NPX_SKILLS          // npx skills for SKILL items + manual MCP config injection
  MANUAL              // config file only
}
```

### 2.3 URL namespace

Collections are namespaced by owner username:

```
/api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json
```

`@@unique([ownerId, slug])` — same slug allowed across different users. Global uniqueness not required.

---

## 3. API Routes

All new routes under `src/app/api/collections/`.

```
src/app/api/collections/
├── route.ts                                    GET (list public) | POST (create)
├── [username]/
│   ├── route.ts                                GET (list user's visible collections)
│   └── [slug]/
│       ├── route.ts                            GET | PATCH | DELETE
│       ├── marketplace.json/
│       │   └── route.ts                        GET — serves marketplace.json
│       └── items/
│           ├── route.ts                        GET | POST (add item)
│           ├── reorder/
│           │   └── route.ts                    POST { itemIds: string[] }
│           └── [itemId]/
│               ├── route.ts                    PATCH | DELETE
│               └── download/
│                   └── route.ts                GET — serves INTERNAL plugin files
```

### 3.1 Route contracts

**`GET /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json`**
- PUBLIC: unauthenticated access allowed
- ADMIN_PRIVATE: requires `PROMPTS_API_KEY` header (existing MCP auth)
- USER_PRIVATE: owner API key only; returns 404 to all others (existence not revealed)
- Response: Claude Code-compatible `marketplace.json`
  - GITHUB items: `source.url = sourceUrl`, `source.ref = sourceRef`
  - INTERNAL items: `source.url = /api/collections/[u]/[s]/items/[id]/download`, `sha = contentHash`
  - LOCAL items: excluded entirely

**`POST /api/collections`**
- Auth: session required
- Phase 1 publisher gate: `assertPublisher(user)` — `username === "le-dawg"`
- Body: `{ slug, name, description?, visibility }`
- Returns: `{ id, slug, marketplaceUrl }`

**`POST /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/reorder`**
- Auth: session, owner only
- Body: `{ itemIds: string[] }` — full desired order
- Bulk-updates `order` values in transaction

**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]`**
- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions

**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions

**`PATCH /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
- Auth: session, owner OR admin (for PUBLIC collections only)
- Admins cannot PATCH items on USER_PRIVATE or ADMIN_PRIVATE collections they don't own

### 3.2 Access matrix

| Visibility | Owner | Invited member | Other admin | le-dawg | Unauthenticated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PUBLIC | R/W/Patch/Delete | — | R/W/Patch | R/W/Patch + unpublish | R |
| ADMIN_PRIVATE | R/W/Patch/Delete | R | R | R | 404 |
| USER_PRIVATE | R/W/Patch/Delete | — | 404 | 404 | 404 |

Delete = owner only across all tiers.
Unpublish (visibility change on others' collections) = le-dawg only.
USER_PRIVATE always returns 404, never 403 — existence not revealed.

---

## 4. MCP Tools

All added to `src/pages/api/mcp.ts`. Auth via existing `authenticateApiKey` pattern.

### 4.1 Collection tools

**`get_collections`**
```
Input:  { username?: string, visibility?: "public"|"admin_private"|"user_private" }
Output: { collections: [{ slug, name, description, visibility, owner, itemCount, marketplaceUrl }] }
```

**`get_collection`**
```
Input:  { username: string, slug: string }
Output: { collection: { ...metadata, items: [{ order, name, type, sourceType, sourceUrl, sourcePath, sourceRef, syncStatus }] } }
```

**`create_collection`**
```
Input:  { slug, name, description?, visibility: "public"|"admin_private"|"user_private" }
Output: { collection: { id, slug, marketplaceUrl } }
Phase 1: rejects unless authenticated user is le-dawg
```

**`update_collection_item`**
```
Input:  { username, slug, action: "add"|"edit"|"remove", itemId?: string, item?: { order?, name, type, sourceType, sourceUrl, sourcePath?, sourceRef?, description? } }
Output: { item }
- "remove" action: owner only
- "add"/"edit": owner OR admin on PUBLIC collections
```

**`reorder_collection`**
```
Input:  { username, slug, itemIds: string[] }
Output: { items: [{ id, order, name }] }
Owner only.
```

**`install_collection`**
```
Input:  { username, slug, agent?: "claude-code"|"copilot-cli"|"codex"|"antigravity"|"kilo"|"cursor"|"windsurf"|"cline"|"opencode" }
Output: {
  commands: string[],          // GITHUB + INTERNAL items only
  skipped: { name, reason }[], // LOCAL items: "local-only — push to GitHub or upload to platform first"
  summary: string
}
```

Install command shape by agent tier:
- Tier 1 (MARKETPLACE_NATIVE): `[agent] plugin marketplace add <marketplaceUrl>` + per-item install commands
- Tier 2 (NPX_SKILLS): `npx skills add <sourceUrl> --agent <npxSkillsFlag>` for SKILL items; config injection snippet for MCP items
- MCP items: always config injection regardless of tier

### 4.2 Onboarding tools

**`set_me_up`**
```
Input:  { targetAgent?: string }
Output: {
  checks: DiagnosticResult[],
  allPassed: boolean,
  installCommands: string[],
  nextSteps: string[],
  collectionUrl: string | null
}
```

Execution phases:

1. **DETECT_AGENT** — infer from MCP transport metadata. Fail → elicit numbered list of 9 supported agents; user types selection.

2. **VERIFY_SESSION** — API key resolves to user with linked GitHub identity. Hard stop if missing: `"Generate an API key at <host>/settings"`

3. **VERIFY_ORG_MEMBERSHIP**
   - Primary: `GET https://api.github.com/orgs/solution8-com/members/{githubUsername}` via NextAuth OAuth token
   - 204 → pass
   - 403 (missing `read:org` scope) → elicitation fallback: `"Run: gh api /orgs/solution8-com/members/{username} — paste the HTTP status"`; 204 from elicit → pass; 404 → fail
   - 404 → hard stop: `"Not a solution8-com org member. Contact le-dawg."`

4. **VERIFY_CLI** — for Tier 1 + Tier 2 CLI agents: elicit `cliCheckCmd` from `AgentConfig`. IDE-only agents (Cline, Windsurf) skip to config injection. Missing CLI → warn + remediation URL from `AgentConfig.docsUrl`.

5. **CHECK_EXISTING_MARKETPLACE** — if user already has collection registered → idempotent success, skip steps 6-7.

6. **SUGGEST_COLLECTION** — list user's PUBLIC + ADMIN_PRIVATE collections. None exist → `"Use create_collection to set up your first collection."` Collections exist → user selects one via elicitation.

7. **GENERATE_INSTALL_COMMANDS** — per detected agent tier, return ready-to-run install commands.

**`update_agent_config`** (admin only)
```
Input:  { agentId: string, action: "fetch"|"write", data?: Partial<AgentConfig> }
Output: { diff?: object, updated?: AgentConfig, status: string }
```
- `action: "fetch"` — fetches `AgentConfig.docsUrl` (allowlisted domains only), returns proposed diff for confirmation
- `action: "write"` — applies confirmed data to DB; rate-limited to 1/hour per agentId per admin; audit-logged

### 4.3 Retained existing tools (unchanged)

### 7.1 Auth helpers (new)


`USER_PRIVATE` queries always append `WHERE ownerId = authenticatedUserId`. Admin role explicitly excluded. Returns 404, never 403.

## 1. Context & Scope

PromptBar becomes a Git-native team distribution platform for Skills and Plugin Marketplaces. This spec covers Phase 1 exclusively.

**Phase 1 delivers:**
- User-owned Collections (named, versioned lists of skills + MCPs)

## 2. Data Model

### 2.1 New Prisma Models

```prisma
model Collection {
  id          String               @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String
  name        String
  description String?
  visibility  CollectionVisibility @default(USER_PRIVATE)
  ownerId     String
  owner       User                 @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  items       CollectionItem[]
  members     CollectionMember[]
  createdAt   DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime             @updatedAt

  @@unique([ownerId, slug])
  @@map("collections")
}

model CollectionItem {
  id           String         @id @default(cuid())
  order        Int
  name         String
  description  String?
  sourceType   ItemSourceType @default(GITHUB)
  sourceUrl    String?        // GitHub/GitLab URL — required when sourceType = GITHUB
  sourcePath   String?        // subdirectory within repo
  sourceRef    String         @default("main")
  promptId     String?        // required when sourceType = INTERNAL
  prompt       Prompt?        @relation(fields: [promptId], references: [id])
  contentHash  String?        // SHA-256 of served content — INTERNAL items only
  type         ItemType
  lastSyncedAt DateTime?
  syncStatus   SyncStatus?
  upstreamRef  String?        // last known upstream commit SHA
  collectionId String
  collection   Collection     @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id])
  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now())

  @@unique([collectionId, order])
  @@map("collection_items")
}

model CollectionMember {
  collectionId String
  userId       String
  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@id([collectionId, userId])
  @@map("collection_members")
}

model AgentConfig {
  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
  agentId           String    @unique  // "claude-code", "copilot-cli", "codex", "antigravity", etc.
  displayName       String
  tier              AgentTier
  pluginRegisterCmd String?   // template string; {host}, {username}, {slug} substituted at runtime
  pluginInstallCmd  String?
  mcpConfigTemplate Json?     // per-agent config injection format
  skillsPathGlobal  String?
  skillsPathProject String?
  npxSkillsFlag     String?   // e.g. "--agent claude"
  cliCheckCmd       String?   // e.g. "claude --version"
  docsUrl           String?   // source for auto-fetch update
  isActive          Boolean   @default(true)
  lastUpdatedAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedById       String?

  @@map("agent_configs")
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  target    String?
  meta      Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}
```

### 2.2 New Enums

```prisma
enum CollectionVisibility {
  PUBLIC        // anyone reads; le-dawg can unpublish others'
  ADMIN_PRIVATE // org admins + invited CollectionMembers read; hidden from public
  USER_PRIVATE  // owner only — no exceptions, returns 404 to all others including admins
}

enum ItemSourceType {
  GITHUB    // sourceUrl points to GitHub/GitLab repo; Claude Code fetches natively
  INTERNAL  // skill stored as Prompt record in platform DB; served via download endpoint
  LOCAL     // lives on user's machine only; excluded from marketplace.json and install commands
}

enum ItemType {
  SKILL
  MCP
}

enum SyncStatus {
  IN_SYNC
  AHEAD
  BEHIND
  DIVERGED
  CONFLICT
  ERROR
}

enum AgentTier {
  MARKETPLACE_NATIVE  // supports marketplace.json + /plugin commands natively
  NPX_SKILLS          // npx skills for SKILL items + manual MCP config injection
  MANUAL              // config file only
}
```

Collections are namespaced by owner username:

```
/api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json
```

`@@unique([ownerId, slug])` — same slug allowed across different users. Global uniqueness not required.

```

├── route.ts                                    GET (list public) | POST (create)
├── [username]/
│   ├── route.ts                                GET (list user's visible collections)
│   └── [slug]/
│       ├── route.ts                            GET | PATCH | DELETE
│       ├── marketplace.json/

```

### 3.1 Route contracts

**`GET /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json`**
- PUBLIC: unauthenticated access allowed
- ADMIN_PRIVATE: requires `PROMPTS_API_KEY` header (existing MCP auth)
- USER_PRIVATE: owner API key only; returns 404 to all others (existence not revealed)
- Response: Claude Code-compatible `marketplace.json`

  - INTERNAL items: `source.url = /api/collections/[u]/[s]/items/[id]/download`, `sha = contentHash`
  - LOCAL items: excluded entirely

**`POST /api/collections`**
- Auth: session required
- Phase 1 publisher gate: `assertPublisher(user)` — `username === "le-dawg"`
- Body: `{ slug, name, description?, visibility }`
- Returns: `{ id, slug, marketplaceUrl }`

**`POST /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/reorder`**
- Auth: session, owner only
- Body: `{ itemIds: string[] }` — full desired order
- Bulk-updates `order` values in transaction

**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]`**
- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions

**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions

**`PATCH /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
- Auth: session, owner OR admin (for PUBLIC collections only)
- Admins cannot PATCH items on USER_PRIVATE or ADMIN_PRIVATE collections they don't own

`AuditLog` written for: `install_collection`, `set_me_up` (with check results), `update_agent_config` (with before/after diff), collection create/delete, visibility changes.

### 7.7 Supply chain mitigations (Phase 1)

| Attack vector | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Malicious script in INTERNAL items | SHA-256 hash verified on install; admin-reviewed |
| Post-install weaponization (GITHUB items) | `upstreamRef` tracks last known SHA; optional pin |
| Namespace collision | `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` scoped to owner |
| SSRF via sourceUrl | Domain allowlist + IP range rejection on write |
| prompt injection in update_agent_config | Fetched content presented as diff — never auto-applied |
| API key in marketplace.json | Never included; auth via header only |

### 8.1 Data model

- `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` enforced; same slug different owner allowed
- `USER_PRIVATE` invisible to other users AND admins — 0 rows, not 403
- `ADMIN_PRIVATE` visible to admins + invited CollectionMembers
- `sourceUrl` SSRF validation: localhost, private IPs, http:// all rejected on write
- `@@unique([collectionId, order])` enforced
- `contentHash` computed correctly on INTERNAL write
- `AuditLog` entry created on sensitive actions

### 8.2 API routes

- `GET marketplace.json` — all visibility tiers × auth states
- LOCAL items excluded from marketplace.json response
- INTERNAL items include download URL + sha in marketplace.json
- `POST /api/collections` — non-admin rejected (Phase 1 gate)
- Delete operations — owner only enforced
- Admin PATCH on PUBLIC collection succeeds; on USER_PRIVATE returns 404
- Rate limits: 61st req → 429

### 8.3 MCP tools

- `get_collections` visibility filtering correct
- `create_collection` non-admin rejected Phase 1
- `update_collection_item remove` — non-owner rejected
- Admin add/edit on PUBLIC collection succeeds; remove returns error
- `install_collection` LOCAL items in `skipped` array, not `commands`
- `install_collection` Tier 1 → marketplace command; Tier 2 → npx skills
- MCP items always config injection regardless of tier
- `set_me_up` idempotent on rerun
- `set_me_up` missing `read:org` scope triggers elicitation
- `set_me_up` non-org member → hard stop + remediation
- `update_agent_config` off-allowlist domain rejected

### 8.4 marketplace.json compliance

- Validates against Claude Code schema
- Copilot CLI, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI can each register endpoint and install
- GITHUB item: correct source URL + ref
- INTERNAL item: download endpoint URL + contentHash as sha

### 8.5 Security

- `USER_PRIVATE` returns 404 not 403 to non-owners
- `contentHash` mismatch on INTERNAL download flagged
- Publisher gate: non-le-dawg rejected Phase 1
- All sensitive actions produce AuditLog rows

### 8.6 End-to-end scenarios

1. New admin: login → settings → MCP connect → `set_me_up` → marketplace registered → `install_collection` → plugin active in agent session
2. Admin creates PUBLIC collection → another admin adds item → owner reorders → Tier 1 agent installs
3. Admin reads another admin's USER_PRIVATE collection via MCP → 404
4. `update_agent_config` fetch → diff presented → admin confirms → `set_me_up` uses updated config

---

## 9. Acceptance Criteria

Phase 1 is done when all are true:

- [ ] User logs into PromptBar via GitHub, verified as solution8-com org member
- [ ] Settings page shows Collections block with marketplace URLs
- [ ] `set_me_up` MCP tool completes all 7 checks for Claude Code with verified auth path
- [ ] All 4 Tier 1 agents can register `marketplace.json` endpoint and install collection items
- [ ] Tier 2 agents install SKILL items via `npx skills`; MCP items via config injection
- [ ] LOCAL items skipped with clear warning in `install_collection`
- [ ] USER_PRIVATE collections return 404 to all non-owners including admins
- [ ] ADMIN_PRIVATE collections visible to org admins + invited members only
- [ ] Delete restricted to owner only across all visibility tiers
- [ ] le-dawg can unpublish other users' PUBLIC collections
- [ ] `update_agent_config` MCP tool fetches from allowlist, presents diff, requires confirmation
- [ ] All sensitive actions produce AuditLog entries
- [ ] SSRF protection rejects private IPs and non-HTTPS sourceUrls
- [ ] INTERNAL items: contentHash computed on write, returned as sha in marketplace.json
- [ ] Rate limits active on all specified endpoints

---

- **BLOCKING (pre-implementation):** Admin plugin review/approval UI — scope before writing-plans
- **MCP audit:** Too many tools exposed in mcp.ts; guide/article content exposed as tools; auth broken
- **Admin template libraries:** Per-user MCP-driven git-versioned collections with complete access isolation
- **URL import:** Paste URL from skills.sh/officialskills.sh → platform fetches and adds to skill list
- **BUG:** MCP skill/article creation reports success but URL is broken (ID+slug concatenation issue)
- **Phase 3 prerequisite:** OAuth scope expansion (`repo` write) + secure token storage for GitHub push sync

---

## 11. Phase Boundaries

| Phase | Scope |
|---|---|
| **1 (this spec)** | Collections, marketplace.json serving, set_me_up, agent compat registry, onboarding UX |
| **2** | .skill upload hardening, manifest standardization, skill sync pull (read-first) |
| **3** | Skill push + conflict resolution, marketplace admin/policy/observability, GitHub write OAuth |
| **4** | Code signing, attestations, strict policy gates, enterprise hardening |

## Instruction Priority

Superpowers skills override default system prompt behavior, but **user instructions always take precedence**:

1. **User's explicit instructions** (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, direct requests) — highest priority
2. **Superpowers skills** — override default system behavior where they conflict
3. **Default system prompt** — lowest priority

If CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, or AGENTS.md says "don't use TDD" and a skill says "always use TDD," follow the user's instructions. The user is in control.

## How to Access Skills

**In Claude Code:** Use the `Skill` tool. When you invoke a skill, its content is loaded and presented to you—follow it directly. Never use the Read tool on skill files.

**In Copilot CLI:** Use the `skill` tool. Skills are auto-discovered from installed plugins. The `skill` tool works the same as Claude Code's `Skill` tool.

**In Gemini CLI:** Skills activate via the `activate_skill` tool. Gemini loads skill metadata at session start and activates the full content on demand.

**In other environments:** Check your platform's documentation for how skills are loaded.

## Platform Adaptation

Skills use Claude Code tool names. Non-CC platforms: see `references/copilot-tools.md` (Copilot CLI), `references/codex-tools.md` (Codex) for tool equivalents. Gemini CLI users get the tool mapping loaded automatically via GEMINI.md.

# Using Skills

## The Rule

**Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action.** Even a 1% chance a skill might apply means that you should invoke the skill to check. If an invoked skill turns out to be wrong for the situation, you don't need to use it.

```dot

    "About to EnterPlanMode?" [shape=doublecircle];

    "About to EnterPlanMode?" -> "Already brainstormed?";
    "Already brainstormed?" -> "Invoke brainstorming skill" [label="no"];
    "Already brainstormed?" -> "Might any skill apply?" [label="yes"];
    "Invoke brainstorming skill" -> "Might any skill apply?";

    "User message received" -> "Might any skill apply?";
    "Might any skill apply?" -> "Invoke Skill tool" [label="yes, even 1%"];
    "Might any skill apply?" -> "Respond (including clarifications)" [label="definitely not"];
    "Invoke Skill tool" -> "Announce: 'Using [skill] to [purpose]'";
    "Announce: 'Using [skill] to [purpose]'" -> "Has checklist?";
    "Has checklist?" -> "Create TodoWrite todo per item" [label="yes"];
    "Has checklist?" -> "Follow skill exactly" [label="no"];
    "Create TodoWrite todo per item" -> "Follow skill exactly";
}
```

## Red Flags

These thoughts mean STOP—you're rationalizing:

| Thought | Reality |
|---------|---------|
| "This is just a simple question" | Questions are tasks. Check for skills. |
| "I need more context first" | Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions. |
| "Let me explore the codebase first" | Skills tell you HOW to explore. Check first. |
| "I can check git/files quickly" | Files lack conversation context. Check for skills. |
| "Let me gather information first" | Skills tell you HOW to gather information. |
| "This doesn't need a formal skill" | If a skill exists, use it. |
| "I remember this skill" | Skills evolve. Read current version. |
| "This doesn't count as a task" | Action = task. Check for skills. |
| "The skill is overkill" | Simple things become complex. Use it. |
| "I'll just do this one thing first" | Check BEFORE doing anything. |
| "This feels productive" | Undisciplined action wastes time. Skills prevent this. |
| "I know what that means" | Knowing the concept ≠ using the skill. Invoke it. |

## Skill Priority

When multiple skills could apply, use this order:

1. **Process skills first** (brainstorming, debugging) - these determine HOW to approach the task
2. **Implementation skills second** (frontend-design, mcp-builder) - these guide execution

"Let's build X" → brainstorming first, then implementation skills.
"Fix this bug" → debugging first, then domain-specific skills.

## Skill Types

**Rigid** (TDD, debugging): Follow exactly. Don't adapt away discipline.

**Flexible** (patterns): Adapt principles to context.

The skill itself tells you which.

## User Instructions

Instructions say WHAT, not HOW. "Add X" or "Fix Y" doesn't mean skip workflows.

1	# PromptBar Phase 1 — Collections & Marketplace Design Spec
2	
3	**Date:** 2026-06-02
4	**Author:** le-dawg + Claude Code
5	**Status:** Approved for implementation planning
6	**Scope:** Phase 1 only — Collections, Marketplace Distribution, `set_me_up`, Agent Compat
7	
8	---
9	
10	## 1. Context & Scope
11	
12	PromptBar becomes a Git-native team distribution platform for Skills and Plugin Marketplaces. This spec covers Phase 1 exclusively.
13	
14	**Phase 1 delivers:**
15	- User-owned Collections (named, versioned lists of skills + MCPs)
16	- Platform-served `marketplace.json` compatible with Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex, Antigravity
17	- `set_me_up` MCP tool — org-verified onboarding + marketplace registration
18	- Agent compatibility registry (`AgentConfig`) — server-side, admin-updatable via MCP
19	- Onboarding UX block in `/settings`
20	- Skills system unchanged
21	
22	**Out of scope (Phase 2+):**
23	- `.skill` upload hardening + manifest standardization
24	- Skill sync pull (Phase 2)
25	- Skill push + conflict resolution (Phase 3)
26	- Code signing, attestations, strict policy gates (Phase 4)
27	- OAuth write scope expansion for GitHub push (Phase 3 prerequisite)
28	
29	---
30	
31	## 2. Data Model
32	
33	### 2.1 New Prisma Models
34	
35	```prisma
36	model Collection {
37	  id          String               @id @default(cuid())
38	  slug        String
39	  name        String
40	  description String?
41	  visibility  CollectionVisibility @default(USER_PRIVATE)
42	  ownerId     String
43	  owner       User                 @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
44	  items       CollectionItem[]
45	  members     CollectionMember[]
46	  createdAt   DateTime             @default(now())
47	  updatedAt   DateTime             @updatedAt
48	
49	  @@unique([ownerId, slug])
50	  @@map("collections")
51	}
52	
53	model CollectionItem {
54	  id           String         @id @default(cuid())
55	  order        Int
56	  name         String
57	  description  String?
58	  sourceType   ItemSourceType @default(GITHUB)
59	  sourceUrl    String?        // GitHub/GitLab URL — required when sourceType = GITHUB
60	  sourcePath   String?        // subdirectory within repo
61	  sourceRef    String         @default("main")
62	  promptId     String?        // required when sourceType = INTERNAL
63	  prompt       Prompt?        @relation(fields: [promptId], references: [id])
64	  contentHash  String?        // SHA-256 of served content — INTERNAL items only
65	  type         ItemType
66	  lastSyncedAt DateTime?
67	  syncStatus   SyncStatus?
68	  upstreamRef  String?        // last known upstream commit SHA
69	  collectionId String
70	  collection   Collection     @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id])
71	  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now())
72	
73	  @@unique([collectionId, order])
74	  @@map("collection_items")
75	}
76	
77	model CollectionMember {
78	  collectionId String
79	  userId       String
80	  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
81	  user         User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
82	  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())
83	
84	  @@id([collectionId, userId])
85	  @@map("collection_members")
86	}
87	
88	model AgentConfig {
89	  id                String    @id @default(cuid())
90	  agentId           String    @unique  // "claude-code", "copilot-cli", "codex", "antigravity", etc.
91	  displayName       String
92	  tier              AgentTier
93	  pluginRegisterCmd String?   // template string; {host}, {username}, {slug} substituted at runtime
94	  pluginInstallCmd  String?
95	  mcpConfigTemplate Json?     // per-agent config injection format
96	  skillsPathGlobal  String?
97	  skillsPathProject String?
98	  npxSkillsFlag     String?   // e.g. "--agent claude"
99	  cliCheckCmd       String?   // e.g. "claude --version"
100	  docsUrl           String?   // source for auto-fetch update
101	  isActive          Boolean   @default(true)
102	  lastUpdatedAt     DateTime  @default(now())
103	  updatedById       String?
104	
105	  @@map("agent_configs")
106	}
107	
108	model AuditLog {
109	  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
110	  userId    String
111	  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
112	  action    String
113	  target    String?
114	  meta      Json?
115	  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
116	
117	  @@index([userId, createdAt])
118	  @@map("audit_logs")
119	}
120	```
121	
122	### 2.2 New Enums
123	
124	```prisma
125	enum CollectionVisibility {
126	  PUBLIC        // anyone reads; le-dawg can unpublish others'
127	  ADMIN_PRIVATE // org admins + invited CollectionMembers read; hidden from public
128	  USER_PRIVATE  // owner only — no exceptions, returns 404 to all others including admins
129	}
130	
131	enum ItemSourceType {
132	  GITHUB    // sourceUrl points to GitHub/GitLab repo; Claude Code fetches natively
133	  INTERNAL  // skill stored as Prompt record in platform DB; served via download endpoint
134	  LOCAL     // lives on user's machine only; excluded from marketplace.json and install commands
135	}
136	
137	enum ItemType {
138	  SKILL
139	  MCP
140	}
141	
142	enum SyncStatus {
143	  IN_SYNC
144	  AHEAD
145	  BEHIND
146	  DIVERGED
147	  CONFLICT
148	  ERROR
149	}
150	
151	enum AgentTier {
152	  MARKETPLACE_NATIVE  // supports marketplace.json + /plugin commands natively
153	  NPX_SKILLS          // npx skills for SKILL items + manual MCP config injection
154	  MANUAL              // config file only
155	}
156	```
157	
158	### 2.3 URL namespace
159	
160	Collections are namespaced by owner username:
161	
162	```
163	/api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json
164	```
165	
166	`@@unique([ownerId, slug])` — same slug allowed across different users. Global uniqueness not required.
167	
168	---
169	
170	## 3. API Routes
171	
172	All new routes under `src/app/api/collections/`.
173	
174	```
175	src/app/api/collections/
176	├── route.ts                                    GET (list public) | POST (create)
177	├── [username]/
178	│   ├── route.ts                                GET (list user's visible collections)
179	│   └── [slug]/
180	│       ├── route.ts                            GET | PATCH | DELETE
181	│       ├── marketplace.json/
182	│       │   └── route.ts                        GET — serves marketplace.json
183	│       └── items/
184	│           ├── route.ts                        GET | POST (add item)
185	│           ├── reorder/
186	│           │   └── route.ts                    POST { itemIds: string[] }
187	│           └── [itemId]/
188	│               ├── route.ts                    PATCH | DELETE
189	│               └── download/
190	│                   └── route.ts                GET — serves INTERNAL plugin files
191	```
192	
193	### 3.1 Route contracts
194	
195	**`GET /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/marketplace.json`**
196	- PUBLIC: unauthenticated access allowed
197	- ADMIN_PRIVATE: requires `PROMPTS_API_KEY` header (existing MCP auth)
198	- USER_PRIVATE: owner API key only; returns 404 to all others (existence not revealed)
199	- Response: Claude Code-compatible `marketplace.json`
200	  - GITHUB items: `source.url = sourceUrl`, `source.ref = sourceRef`
201	  - INTERNAL items: `source.url = /api/collections/[u]/[s]/items/[id]/download`, `sha = contentHash`
202	  - LOCAL items: excluded entirely
203	
204	**`POST /api/collections`**
205	- Auth: session required
206	- Phase 1 publisher gate: `assertPublisher(user)` — `username === "le-dawg"`
207	- Body: `{ slug, name, description?, visibility }`
208	- Returns: `{ id, slug, marketplaceUrl }`
209	
210	**`POST /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/reorder`**
211	- Auth: session, owner only
212	- Body: `{ itemIds: string[] }` — full desired order
213	- Bulk-updates `order` values in transaction
214	
215	**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]`**
216	- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions
217	
218	**`DELETE /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
219	- Auth: session, owner only — no exceptions
220	
221	**`PATCH /api/collections/[username]/[slug]/items/[itemId]`**
222	- Auth: session, owner OR admin (for PUBLIC collections only)
223	- Admins cannot PATCH items on USER_PRIVATE or ADMIN_PRIVATE collections they don't own
224	
225	### 3.2 Access matrix
226	
227	| Visibility | Owner | Invited member | Other admin | le-dawg | Unauthenticated |
228	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
229	| PUBLIC | R/W/Patch/Delete | — | R/W/Patch | R/W/Patch + unpublish | R |
230	| ADMIN_PRIVATE | R/W/Patch/Delete | R | R | R | 404 |
231	| USER_PRIVATE | R/W/Patch/Delete | — | 404 | 404 | 404 |
232	
233	Delete = owner only across all tiers.
234	Unpublish (visibility change on others' collections) = le-dawg only.
235	USER_PRIVATE always returns 404, never 403 — existence not revealed.
236	
237	---
238	
239	## 4. MCP Tools
240	
241	All added to `src/pages/api/mcp.ts`. Auth via existing `authenticateApiKey` pattern.
242	
243	### 4.1 Collection tools
244	
245	**`get_collections`**
246	```
247	Input:  { username?: string, visibility?: "public"|"admin_private"|"user_private" }
248	Output: { collections: [{ slug, name, description, visibility, owner, itemCount, marketplaceUrl }] }
249	```
250	
251	**`get_collection`**
252	```
253	Input:  { username: string, slug: string }
254	Output: { collection: { ...metadata, items: [{ order, name, type, sourceType, sourceUrl, sourcePath, sourceRef, syncStatus }] } }
255	```
256	
257	**`create_collection`**
258	```
259	Input:  { slug, name, description?, visibility: "public"|"admin_private"|"user_private" }
260	Output: { collection: { id, slug, marketplaceUrl } }
261	Phase 1: rejects unless authenticated user is le-dawg
262	```
263	
264	**`update_collection_item`**
265	```
266	Input:  { username, slug, action: "add"|"edit"|"remove", itemId?: string, item?: { order?, name, type, sourceType, sourceUrl, sourcePath?, sourceRef?, description? } }
267	Output: { item }
268	- "remove" action: owner only
269	- "add"/"edit": owner OR admin on PUBLIC collections
270	```
271	
272	**`reorder_collection`**
273	```
274	Input:  { username, slug, itemIds: string[] }
275	Output: { items: [{ id, order, name }] }
276	Owner only.
277	```
278	
279	**`install_collection`**
280	```
281	Input:  { username, slug, agent?: "claude-code"|"copilot-cli"|"codex"|"antigravity"|"kilo"|"cursor"|"windsurf"|"cline"|"opencode" }
282	Output: {
283	  commands: string[],          // GITHUB + INTERNAL items only
284	  skipped: { name, reason }[], // LOCAL items: "local-only — push to GitHub or upload to platform first"
285	  summary: string
286	}
287	```
288	
289	Install command shape by agent tier:
290	- Tier 1 (MARKETPLACE_NATIVE): `[agent] plugin marketplace add <marketplaceUrl>` + per-item install commands
291	- Tier 2 (NPX_SKILLS): `npx skills add <sourceUrl> --agent <npxSkillsFlag>` for SKILL items; config injection snippet for MCP items
292	- MCP items: always config injection regardless of tier
293	
294	### 4.2 Onboarding tools
295	
296	**`set_me_up`**
297	```
298	Input:  { targetAgent?: string }
299	Output: {
300	  checks: DiagnosticResult[],
301	  allPassed: boolean,
302	  installCommands: string[],
303	  nextSteps: string[],
304	  collectionUrl: string | null
305	}
306	```
307	
308	Execution phases:
309	
310	1. **DETECT_AGENT** — infer from MCP transport metadata. Fail → elicit numbered list of 9 supported agents; user types selection.
311	
312	2. **VERIFY_SESSION** — API key resolves to user with linked GitHub identity. Hard stop if missing: `"Generate an API key at <host>/settings"`
313	
314	3. **VERIFY_ORG_MEMBERSHIP**
315	   - Primary: `GET https://api.github.com/orgs/solution8-com/members/{githubUsername}` via NextAuth OAuth token
316	   - 204 → pass
317	   - 403 (missing `read:org` scope) → elicitation fallback: `"Run: gh api /orgs/solution8-com/members/{username} — paste the HTTP status"`; 204 from elicit → pass; 404 → fail
318	   - 404 → hard stop: `"Not a solution8-com org member. Contact le-dawg."`
319	
320	4. **VERIFY_CLI** — for Tier 1 + Tier 2 CLI agents: elicit `cliCheckCmd` from `AgentConfig`. IDE-only agents (Cline, Windsurf) skip to config injection. Missing CLI → warn + remediation URL from `AgentConfig.docsUrl`.
321	
322	5. **CHECK_EXISTING_MARKETPLACE** — if user already has collection registered → idempotent success, skip steps 6-7.
323	
324	6. **SUGGEST_COLLECTION** — list user's PUBLIC + ADMIN_PRIVATE collections. None exist → `"Use create_collection to set up your first collection."` Collections exist → user selects one via elicitation.
325	
326	7. **GENERATE_INSTALL_COMMANDS** — per detected agent tier, return ready-to-run install commands.
327	
328	**`update_agent_config`** (admin only)
329	```
330	Input:  { agentId: string, action: "fetch"|"write", data?: Partial<AgentConfig> }
331	Output: { diff?: object, updated?: AgentConfig, status: string }
332	```
333	- `action: "fetch"` — fetches `AgentConfig.docsUrl` (allowlisted domains only), returns proposed diff for confirmation
334	- `action: "write"` — applies confirmed data to DB; rate-limited to 1/hour per agentId per admin; audit-logged
335	
336	### 4.3 Retained existing tools (unchanged)
337	
338	`save_skill`, `add_file_to_skill`, `update_skill_file`, `remove_file_from_skill`, `get_skill`, `search_skills`, `create_skill_comment`
339	
340	---
341	
342	## 5. Agent Compatibility Registry
343	
344	### 5.1 Supported agents — Phase 1
345	
346	**Tier 1: MARKETPLACE_NATIVE** — native `marketplace.json` + `/plugin` commands
347	
348	| agentId | displayName | pluginRegisterCmd | cliCheckCmd |
349	|---|---|---|---|
350	| `claude-code` | Claude Code | `claude mcp add ... && /plugin marketplace add {url}` | `claude --version` |
351	| `copilot-cli` | GitHub Copilot CLI | `copilot plugin marketplace add {url}` | `copilot --version` |
352	| `codex` | Codex CLI | `codex plugin marketplace add {url}` | `codex --version` |
353	| `antigravity` | Antigravity CLI | `/plugin marketplace add {url}` | `agy --version` |
354	
355	**Tier 2: NPX_SKILLS** — `npx skills` for SKILL items + config injection for MCP
356	
357	| agentId | displayName | npxSkillsFlag | skillsPathGlobal | cliCheckCmd |
358	|---|---|---|---|---|
359	| `kilo-code` | Kilo Code | `--agent kilo` | `~/.config/kilo/` | `kilo --version` |
360	| `cursor` | Cursor | `--agent cursor` | `~/.cursor/skills/` | `cursor --version` |
361	| `windsurf` | Windsurf | `--agent windsurf` | `~/.codeium/windsurf/skills/` | _(IDE — skip)_ |
362	| `cline` | Cline | `--agent cline` | `~/.cline/data/` | _(IDE — skip)_ |
363	| `opencode` | OpenCode | `--agent opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/` | `opencode --version` |
364	
365	### 5.2 `npx skills` install path logic
366	
367	```
368	SKILL item + Tier 1 agent  → /plugin install via marketplace.json
369	SKILL item + Tier 2 agent  + GitHub sync URL  → npx skills add <sourceUrl> --agent <flag>
370	SKILL item + Tier 2 agent  + INTERNAL source  → config injection (download URL)
371	MCP  item + any agent      → config injection from AgentConfig.mcpConfigTemplate
372	LOCAL item + any agent     → skipped, warning returned
373	```
374	
375	---
376	
377	## 6. Onboarding UX
378	
379	Extension to `src/app/settings/page.tsx`. No new page.
380	
381	New section below existing API key block:
382	
383	```
384	── Agent Setup (existing McpConfigTabs) ─────────────────────
385	── Collections & Marketplace (NEW) ──────────────────────────
386	
387	Your collections appear as installable marketplaces in Claude
388	Code and other supported agents.
389	
390	Quick setup via MCP:
391	  Use `set_me_up` in your connected agent session to complete
392	  marketplace setup automatically.
393	
394	Manual setup:
395	  [List of user's collections with marketplace.json URLs]
396	  [Copy button per URL]
397	```
398	
399	`[username]` profile page: PUBLIC collections listed read-only. No onboarding block.
400	
401	---
402	
403	## 7. Auth & Security
404	
405	### 7.1 Auth helpers (new)
406	
407	```typescript
408	assertPublisher(user)         // Phase 1: username === "le-dawg"
409	assertOwner(user, collection) // collection.ownerId === user.id
410	assertAdminOrOwner(user, collection) // owner OR user.role === ADMIN
411	```
412	
413	### 7.2 Access control — DB query layer
414	
415	`USER_PRIVATE` queries always append `WHERE ownerId = authenticatedUserId`. Admin role explicitly excluded. Returns 404, never 403.
416	
417	`ADMIN_PRIVATE` queries: `WHERE ownerId = userId OR role = ADMIN OR EXISTS(CollectionMember WHERE userId = authenticatedUserId)`
418	
419	### 7.3 SSRF protection
420	
421	`CollectionItem.sourceUrl` validated on write:
422	- Must match `https://github.com/` or `https://gitlab.com/`
423	- Reject: `localhost`, `127.x`, `10.x`, `192.168.x`, `169.254.x`, IPv6 loopback, non-HTTPS
424	
425	`update_agent_config` fetch allowlist:
426	```
427	github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, docs.anthropic.com,
428	cursor.com, openai.com, kilo.ai, docs.windsurf.com,
429	cline.bot, docs.github.com, antigravity.google
430	```
431	
432	### 7.4 Content integrity
433	
434	INTERNAL items: SHA-256 of served file content stored in `CollectionItem.contentHash`. Returned as `sha` field in `marketplace.json`. Tier 1 agents verify on install.
435	
436	### 7.5 Rate limits
437	
438	| Endpoint | Limit | Scope |
439	|---|---|---|
440	| `GET marketplace.json` (unauth) | 60 req/min | per IP |
441	| `GET marketplace.json` (auth) | 300 req/min | per API key |
442	| `set_me_up` | 10 req/hour | per user |
443	| `update_agent_config` | 1 req/hour | per agentId per admin |
444	| `install_collection` | 30 req/hour | per user |
445	
446	### 7.6 Audit logging
447	
448	`AuditLog` written for: `install_collection`, `set_me_up` (with check results), `update_agent_config` (with before/after diff), collection create/delete, visibility changes.
449	
450	### 7.7 Supply chain mitigations (Phase 1)
451	
452	| Attack vector | Mitigation |
453	|---|---|
454	| Malicious script in INTERNAL items | SHA-256 hash verified on install; admin-reviewed |
455	| Post-install weaponization (GITHUB items) | `upstreamRef` tracks last known SHA; optional pin |
456	| Namespace collision | `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` scoped to owner |
457	| SSRF via sourceUrl | Domain allowlist + IP range rejection on write |
458	| prompt injection in update_agent_config | Fetched content presented as diff — never auto-applied |
459	| API key in marketplace.json | Never included; auth via header only |
460	
461	Not mitigated Phase 1 (Phase 4): code signing, sandboxing, supply chain attestations.
462	
463	---
464	
465	## 8. Testing Matrix
466	
467	### 8.1 Data model
468	
469	- `@@unique([ownerId, slug])` enforced; same slug different owner allowed
470	- `USER_PRIVATE` invisible to other users AND admins — 0 rows, not 403
471	- `ADMIN_PRIVATE` visible to admins + invited CollectionMembers
472	- `sourceUrl` SSRF validation: localhost, private IPs, http:// all rejected on write
473	- `@@unique([collectionId, order])` enforced
474	- `contentHash` computed correctly on INTERNAL write
475	- `AuditLog` entry created on sensitive actions
476	
477	### 8.2 API routes
478	
479	- `GET marketplace.json` — all visibility tiers × auth states
480	- LOCAL items excluded from marketplace.json response
481	- INTERNAL items include download URL + sha in marketplace.json
482	- `POST /api/collections` — non-admin rejected (Phase 1 gate)
483	- Delete operations — owner only enforced
484	- Admin PATCH on PUBLIC collection succeeds; on USER_PRIVATE returns 404
485	- Rate limits: 61st req → 429
486	
487	### 8.3 MCP tools
488	
489	- `get_collections` visibility filtering correct
490	- `create_collection` non-admin rejected Phase 1
491	- `update_collection_item remove` — non-owner rejected
492	- Admin add/edit on PUBLIC collection succeeds; remove returns error
493	- `install_collection` LOCAL items in `skipped` array, not `commands`
494	- `install_collection` Tier 1 → marketplace command; Tier 2 → npx skills
495	- MCP items always config injection regardless of tier
496	- `set_me_up` idempotent on rerun
497	- `set_me_up` missing `read:org` scope triggers elicitation
498	- `set_me_up` non-org member → hard stop + remediation
499	- `update_agent_config` off-allowlist domain rejected
500	
501	### 8.4 marketplace.json compliance
502	
503	- Validates against Claude Code schema
504	- Copilot CLI, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI can each register endpoint and install
505	- GITHUB item: correct source URL + ref
506	- INTERNAL item: download endpoint URL + contentHash as sha
507	
508	### 8.5 Security
509	
510	- `USER_PRIVATE` returns 404 not 403 to non-owners
511	- `contentHash` mismatch on INTERNAL download flagged
512	- Publisher gate: non-le-dawg rejected Phase 1
513	- All sensitive actions produce AuditLog rows
514	
515	### 8.6 End-to-end scenarios
516	
517	1. New admin: login → settings → MCP connect → `set_me_up` → marketplace registered → `install_collection` → plugin active in agent session
518	2. Admin creates PUBLIC collection → another admin adds item → owner reorders → Tier 1 agent installs
519	3. Admin reads another admin's USER_PRIVATE collection via MCP → 404
520	4. `update_agent_config` fetch → diff presented → admin confirms → `set_me_up` uses updated config
521	
522	---
523	
524	## 9. Acceptance Criteria
525	
526	Phase 1 is done when all are true:
527

529	- [ ] Settings page shows Collections block with marketplace URLs
530	- [ ] `set_me_up` MCP tool completes all 7 checks for Claude Code with verified auth path
531	- [ ] All 4 Tier 1 agents can register `marketplace.json` endpoint and install collection items
532	- [ ] Tier 2 agents install SKILL items via `npx skills`; MCP items via config injection
533	- [ ] LOCAL items skipped with clear warning in `install_collection`
534	- [ ] USER_PRIVATE collections return 404 to all non-owners including admins
535	- [ ] ADMIN_PRIVATE collections visible to org admins + invited members only
536	- [ ] Delete restricted to owner only across all visibility tiers
537	- [ ] le-dawg can unpublish other users' PUBLIC collections
538	- [ ] `update_agent_config` MCP tool fetches from allowlist, presents diff, requires confirmation
539	- [ ] All sensitive actions produce AuditLog entries
540	- [ ] SSRF protection rejects private IPs and non-HTTPS sourceUrls
541	- [ ] INTERNAL items: contentHash computed on write, returned as sha in marketplace.json
542	- [ ] Rate limits active on all specified endpoints
543	
544	---
545	
546	## 10. Backlog Items (logged, not in Phase 1 scope)
547	
548	- **BLOCKING (pre-implementation):** Admin plugin review/approval UI — scope before writing-plans
549	- **MCP audit:** Too many tools exposed in mcp.ts; guide/article content exposed as tools; auth broken
550	- **Admin template libraries:** Per-user MCP-driven git-versioned collections with complete access isolation
551	- **URL import:** Paste URL from skills.sh/officialskills.sh → platform fetches and adds to skill list
